clue.text: Disparaging words may be snarled

indicators.note: the words may be suggest the following word could be turned into something else, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Insults can be growled out rather than spoken.
explanation.definitionFit: Slander is false spoken defamation, a stream of damaging remarks about someone.

clue.text: Established way of procedure in the main

definitions.text: Established way of procedure in the main

parts.words: Established way of procedure in the main
parts.note: reads as a usual practice in general, but 'the main' is the open sea and the way is a shipping route

explanation.surface: The standard method for doing things, generally speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the main' looks like 'mostly' but is the main, an old word for the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A recognised shipping route across the ocean, the 'main' being an old word for the sea.

clue.text: A medical man, taking a break, aims to tan

indicators.note: the words are broken apart and the letters rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor on holiday hopes to get a suntan.
explanation.definitionFit: An anatomist studies the structure of the body, a scientist of medicine.

clue.text: On reflection the fellow would accept a word of thanks in the end

indicators.note: reflection in a mirror turns things round, so the whole is read backwards
to accept is to take in, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: he'd is short for he would
ta is British informal for thank you

explanation.surface: Looking back, the man would say thank you at the finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Death is the end of life, the final ending.

clue.text: Proceeds — note the change

parts.note: re is a note of the sol-fa scale
a turn is a change, as in a turn of events

explanation.surface: Moves on, observing that things have shifted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Proceeds' looks like a verb but is the noun: money taken.
explanation.definitionFit: A return is the profit or income from an investment, money taken in.

clue.text: Firm measures are taken in the Russian capital

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a peck is an old dry measure of grain, so measures gives PECKS

explanation.surface: Strict steps are being imposed in Moscow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' looks like a city (Moscow) but means money: the copeck is a hundredth of a rouble.
explanation.definitionFit: Copecks are small Russian coins, so collectively they are Russian money or capital.

clue.text: Drinking song sung at Christmas all round America

indicators.note: all round tells us one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: a carol is a Christmas song
USA is America

explanation.surface: A festive drinking song performed across the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A carousal is a bout of noisy drinking and revelry.

clue.text: Country music

parts.note: reads as the American genre, but means music evoking rural life

explanation.surface: A request for country and western.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Country music' is not the Nashville genre but music with a rural theme.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastorale is a composition depicting rustic, rural scenes.

clue.text: Boat building know-how

explanation.surface: The skill needed to construct a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: A craft is a vessel on water; craft is also skill, as in the know-how of a builder.

clue.text: Watch an attendant to find evidence of a leak

parts.note: to see is to watch
a page is a young attendant

explanation.surface: A servant is observed to establish proof of a security breach.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leak' suggests leaked secrets, but it is a liquid escaping.
explanation.definitionFit: Seepage is liquid slowly escaping, which reveals there is a leak.

clue.text: Organising a check on a social worker is hard

parts.note: a dam checks the flow of water
the ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: Putting controls on a social services employee is a tough business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organising' just sets the pieces in order here; 'social worker' is not a person in social services but the ant, a social insect.
explanation.definitionFit: Adamant originally named a legendary hard stone, and as an adjective it means unyielding.

clue.text: In the pink, so got up and breakfasted

parts.note: to get up in the morning is to rise, past tense rose
having breakfasted, one ate

explanation.surface: Feeling great, someone rose and had breakfast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the pink' looks like 'in good health' but is taken literally as pink-coloured.
explanation.definitionFit: Roseate means rose-coloured, a rosy pink shade.

clue.text: Further drink is quite a different matter!

explanation.surface: Offering more tea versus a quite separate issue.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally a second serving of the national beverage; idiomatically, a phrase meaning something entirely different.

clue.text: Being no longer number one, went before ousted

parts.note: EX is the prefix for former, no longer
I is the Roman numeral for one
to lead is to go before, past tense led

explanation.surface: A former leader who used to head the pack has been deposed.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone exiled has been banished, driven out of their country.

clue.text: The decorator forever going around to select trainees

indicators.note: going around tells us one piece encloses the others

parts.note: e'er is a poetic contraction of ever, forever
to name is to select or choose
L stands for learner, so LL is two learners or trainees

explanation.surface: A painter is endlessly picking new apprentices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The decorator' suggests a house painter but here means someone who applies glossy coatings.
explanation.definitionFit: An enameller decorates objects by coating them with vitreous glaze.

clue.text: Constituents scared at seeing a register of property

indicators.note: constituents are the parts of something, so the letters of the words are taken as parts to be reassembled

explanation.surface: Voters are alarmed on seeing an official list of land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constituents' looks like voters but signals that the letters of 'scared at' are the components to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A cadastre is an official land survey record of ownership and boundaries.

clue.text: Having dug one, the construction strengthened

indicators.note: construction is building something new out of the parts, so the letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: After digging one, the building was made sturdier.
explanation.definitionFit: To toughen is to make harder or more resilient.

clue.text: Lively exchange concerning some key' point

parts.note: re means concerning
part means some of
E is a musical key
E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: A heated discussion about part of a key matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Repartee is quick witty conversation of retorts.

clue.text: Once more goes over — touching evidence

parts.note: RE means about or concerning, as touching does
traces are signs left behind, evidence

explanation.surface: Someone goes back over moving testimony once again.
explanation.definitionFit: To retrace is to go back over the same path or steps again.

clue.text: He simply will not have scraps over the river

indicators.note: in a down clue over places one piece above the next

parts.note: refuse is rubbish, scraps

explanation.surface: A man flatly declines leftovers floating on the river.
explanation.definitionFit: A refuser is someone who declines; he simply says no.

clue.text: Fast dog kept in view

indicators.note: kept in tells us one piece is held inside another

parts.note: to see is to view
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A speedy hound stays in sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fast' looks like speedy, but means firmly fixed.
explanation.definitionFit: Fast in the sense of firmly fixed or tied, as in held fast.

clue.text: Hype for a hearing device that won't help anyone's hearing!

definitions.text: device that won't help anyone's hearing!

indicators.note: for a means the second piece is intended for the first, so the first comes before

parts.note: an ear is a hearing, as in getting a sympathetic ear
a plug is publicity, hype

explanation.surface: Promoting a hearing aid that actually blocks sound.
explanation.definitionFit: An earplug blocks sound out, so it hinders listening.

clue.text: Credit's arranged without the right declaration being made

definitions.note: singular phrase for a plural answer: decrees issued

indicators.note: arranged means the letters are put into a new order
without means a piece is removed

parts.note: the letters of the word with its s
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Finance terms are set up minus the right of appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: Edicts are official orders or proclamations issued by authority.

clue.text: For the men hard at work, responsible for production

indicators.note: the letters are put to work, worked into a new order

explanation.surface: Workers on the factory floor are the ones who make output happen.
explanation.walkthrough: Production here is of children, not goods: parents are responsible for that.
explanation.definitionFit: Parents together produce offspring, so they are responsible for the production of a child.

clue.text: A large cask is used for port

parts.note: a tun is a large cask for wine or beer

explanation.surface: A big barrel used for holding fortified wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the wine but is a harbour: Tunis is the Tunisian capital and port.
explanation.definitionFit: Tunis is a Mediterranean port city in North Africa.

clue.text: All correct a sanctimonious beast

parts.note: OK means all correct
pi is informal for pious, sanctimonious

explanation.surface: A self-righteous animal declares everything fine.
explanation.definitionFit: The okapi is an African mammal related to the giraffe.

clue.text: Just one T shirt or vest

parts.note: single means only one

explanation.surface: A lone tee from a clothing list.
explanation.definitionFit: A singlet is a sleeveless undershirt worn as a vest or athletic top.

clue.text: A course from which Anne learned a great deal

indicators.note: from tells us the answer is taken out of the run of words that follow

explanation.surface: A class that taught a woman named Anne a lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' looks like a class of study, but means a watercourse or route.
explanation.definitionFit: A channel is a course along which water flows or a route taken.

clue.text: The lowest price acceptable is a pound

explanation.surface: A minimum bid set at one pound.
explanation.definitionFit: An auction's reserve is the minimum price a seller will take; a reserve or pound is an enclosed area where animals are kept.

clue.text: It's a party — show a bit of leg, understand?

parts.note: the shin is part of the leg
dig is slang for understand

explanation.surface: Someone at a party asks if you get it when legs are shown.
explanation.definitionFit: A shindig is a lively informal party or celebration.
